extracted_from.facts: README.md and build.py (four pages, shared header and footer, no cookies, analytics, trackers or third-party requests, GitHub Pages with .nojekyll, the TikTok URL-prefix verification file)

motif: banner = the site's own page: header with the brand, its headline, a lead that says what the repository is, and the four pages as four of its cards (path, title, what the page says).
